description: This file defines the DataTransform class with methods for sanitizing, filtering, and processing data related to CRM entities, including handling references, owner fields, date, and currency fields, specifically for the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: DataTransform
classes.description: A utility class for transforming and sanitizing data before database operations in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithColumn
methods.description: Sanitizes a data row by mapping columns to fields and processing references, owner fields, and other sanitizations.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithCountColumn
methods.description: Handles sanitization for count(*) columns, returning a count key.

methods.name: filterAndSanitize
methods.description: Filters and sanitizes a data row.

methods.name: sanitizeData
methods.description: Performs reference, owner, and field sanitizations on a data row.

methods.name: sanitizeForInsert
methods.description: Prepares data for insertion, handling special cases for emails, events, calendar, and date/currency fields.

methods.name: filterAllColumns
methods.description: Filters all columns based on metadata field-column mapping.

methods.name: sanitizeFields
methods.description: Sanitizes individual fields, including ID and entity-specific adjustments.

methods.name: sanitizeReferences
methods.description: Resolves reference fields to valid IDs, handling related entity existence.

methods.name: sanitizeOwnerFields
methods.description: Converts owner fields to proper IDs.
